policy.unitOfWork: A shared contract signature that can promote many catalog rows together; never a single slider unless it is genuinely unique.
policy.selection: Lowest wave order first, then highest row fan-out, while skipping explicit external blockers.
policy.implementationPromotion: Derived only from the live source catalog. Manual overrides may describe gaps and ownership but cannot promote a row to full.
policy.certificationSeparation: Implementation closure and formal Office/public/visual certification are independent counters.
policy.expensiveProofCadence: Cheap deterministic checks during construction; one consolidated expensive proof at a coherent family checkpoint and final certification after implementation closure.
